min_recovery_altitude_proposed.description: Minimum recovery altitude for stalls and slow flight tasks that the NPRM proposed for the sport pilot PTS for Airplane, Gyroplane and Glider categories (FAA-S-8081-29B), in feet AGL.

min_recovery_altitude_final.description: Minimum recovery altitude for stalls and slow flight tasks adopted in this final rule for the sport pilot PTS for Airplane, Gyroplane and Glider categories (FAA-S-8081-29B), in feet AGL.

max_stall_speed_knots.description: Maximum stall speed, in knots, of aircraft a sport pilot may operate under the performance limits in section 61.316.
